affected_rows.before: Evaluating open-domain QA requires robust metrics. We benchmark semantic similarity, token-level overlap F1, and model-based judge verdicts to quantify RAG answer correctness across noisy corpus conditions.

affected_rows.title: Mitigating Ghost Vectors in Dense Retrieval via Idempotent Indexing
affected_rows.before: Soft-deletions in vector databases leave orphaned embeddings that lead to hallucinations. This paper designs an idempotent index synchronization protocol that guarantees complete purges of outdated vector artifacts.

affected_rows.title: Hybrid Search Architectures: Combining BM25 with Dense Representations
affected_rows.before: Dense vector search excels at conceptual similarity but struggles with exact acronyms and serial numbers. Reciprocal Rank Fusion of sparse lexical scores and dense embeddings achieves optimal recall.

affected_rows.title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
affected_rows.before: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly improves large language model accuracy by grounding responses in retrieved passages. We explore agentic multi-hop reasoning and routing across heterogeneous vector indices.
